about_text: I build tools, bots and small products that scratch my own itch — then ship them so others can use them too. From game automation to web apps, I like turning repetitive problems into clean, working software.
fact_applang: languages in my Google Play game
proj_sub: A few projects I'm proud of — web apps and tools made to be actually useful.
proj_carto: A strategic online collectible card game — collect dragons, build decks and battle friends in classic and attribute duels. Server-authoritative and trilingual (EN/PT/ES).
proj_coin: A personal investing platform: automate Binance crypto trades (DCA, take-profit, price alerts) and track your B3 stock portfolio and dividends — all in one dashboard.
proj_warframe: A farm-location search engine for Warframe: where every item drops, which relics are vaulted, live Void fissures and Nightwave guides. 4,400+ item pages in 4 languages.
proj_retroasm: A free in-browser IDE and simulator for a 16-bit retro Assembly CPU — syntax highlighting, a 40×30 terminal, breakpoints and step-by-step debugging. Ships with a Bomberman written in Assembly.
proj_rhyme: A real-time rhyme & freestyle trainer: speak into the mic and instantly see perfect and slant rhymes in PT, EN and ES. Free, right in the browser.
proj_cheri: E-commerce site for an artisan confectionery from São Carlos: catalog, seasonal menus and WhatsApp ordering.
proj_vsdragon: Storefront for a hand-printed anime t-shirt brand from Porto: collections, best-sellers and a Portuguese checkout.
proj_terraria: A modded Terraria (tModLoader) server with a live status page: players online, world state, mod list and how to join.
proj_primordium: A crafting game inspired by the book 'How to Invent Everything': combine elements and technologies to rebuild civilization from scratch.
ttv_desc: Tic-tac-toe, evolved: the flagship Ultimate mode (9 boards in one — your move decides where the rival plays), plus Chaos and Shift modes, a 3-level CPU and local 2-player.
ttv_how: Free on Google Play, in 6 languages (EN, PT, ES, HI, BN, NE).
games_sub: Games I've made and published, servers I host and bots for the games I play.
game_desc: An autoplay bot for Hero Wars: Dominion Era. It automates the repetitive grind — climbing the Tower and conquering the Titan's Dungeon — so you can focus on the fun parts of the game.
game_how: Download it, read the README, follow the steps and run the executable. Windows only.

tools_sub: Small, focused tools I made to make daily work less annoying.
tool1_d: Run a Tor Snowflake proxy from your browser to help people bypass internet censorship.
tool2_d: Keeps your machine awake by simulating tiny mouse movements. Windows, macOS & Linux.
tool3_d: Convert IP addresses between decimal, binary, hex and other formats — right in the browser.
tool4_d: Clone installed Android apps into multiple independent instances — repackaged and re-signed on your own device. No root, no ads.
